definition: Whether two classes can be divided by a hyperplane in activation space, and across 4 sources the property that licenses probing and is repeatedly shown not to license anything else. The corpus's central instance: concept recoverability and concept influence come apart -- one bias analysis finds sparse autoencoders improving the first while attenuating the second, which is the detection-versus-control gap stated in a different vocabulary. A second: a simpler linear probe is consistently stronger than a kernel-derived concept vector on a human-annotated benchmark, so more expressive readouts do not automatically buy more. A third is architectural: which steering strategy stays stable depends on the conditioning pathway, so separability at a site does not imply intervenability at that site. The archive's operative position is that separability is well established for reading and says nothing about writing, and that a probe's success is compatible with its having latched onto lexical surface patterns unless a null control says otherwise.

evidence.note: Extends Concept Activation Vector bias analysis to neural L2 speaking graders, and finds concept recoverability and concept influence come apart, with SAEs improving the first while attenuating the second.
evidence.title: Bias Analysis of L2 Speaking Assessment Systems Using Concept Activation Vectors

evidence.note: Applies linear probing, the logit and tuned lenses, activation patching and difference-in-means steering to two public text-to-MIDI models, and shows that the architecture of the conditioning pathway determines which steering strategy stays stable.
evidence.title: MI-MIDI: Mechanistic Interpretability of Text-to-MIDI Generation Models via Probing, Lenses and Steering

evidence.note: Compares linear probes against RFM-derived concept vectors for reading how much a sentence concerns a concept out of a frozen LLM's activations, on a human-annotated ESG benchmark, and finds the simpler probe consistently stronger.
evidence.title: Measuring Concept Content in Text from LLM Activations: ESG Evidence from Concept Vectors and Linear Probes

evidence.note: Detects the class of hallucination where a model confidently fabricates a parameter the user never gave, by running a LoRA adapter alongside the frozen model that restructures the residual stream and then names the offending parameter in words the agent can act on.
evidence.title: Actionable Hallucination Detection: Translating Latent Uncertainty into Agentic Critique
